name: Advisor
source:
The referring doctor of [url=/c78567]Takuya[/url], [url=/c78569]Satou[/url] and [url=/c78568]Taishi[/url]. It's to him that they must give reports and it's also him who gives them homework to do and missions to accomplish.

Serious and strict with his students and colleagues at work, he is much more friendly and relaxed during break times.

[spoiler]Even if he doesn't show it, he is very curious to know with his colleague the [url=/c78571]head nurse[/url] how progresses the romance between Takuya and [url=/c67272]Mio[/url].[/spoiler]
